text:
To find the length of every side of the CMU foundation wall, we can trace the perimeter starting from the top-left corner and going clockwise:

1. Top main wall: 46 ft
2. Top-right vertical step down: 2 ft
3. Top-right horizontal wall: 14 ft
4. Right end wall: 16 ft
5. Bottom-right horizontal wall: 14 ft
6. Bottom-right vertical step down: 12 ft
7. Bottom main wall: 46 ft
8. Left end wall: 30 ft

SIDES: 46, 2, 14, 16, 14, 12, 46, 30
